articles.title: U.S. widens Iran crackdown to encompass crypto, gold, shipping and technology
articles.snippet: Treasury says Ivan Obukhov processed over $100 million in crypto for IRGC-QF oil sales since 2023.

articles.title: Crypto rally spills into dog and cat memecoins as smaller tokens double in a week
articles.snippet: Robinhood Chain-based Cash Cat jumped more than 50% in a day, while several smaller animal-themed tokens have gained between 50% and 130% over the past week.

articles.title: Bitcoin traders place $2.9 million bet on a rapid price jump above $82,000
articles.snippet: Traders are spending millions to position for further Bitcoin upside after its staggering rally to $80,000, though demand for downside protection remains firm, according to Laevitas.

articles.title: Strategy’s $66B Bitcoin machine hinges on capital markets, not BTC price: Report
articles.snippet: Strategy’s biggest risk may not be a Bitcoin crash, but losing access to the capital markets that help it service $1.76 billion in annual obligations.

articles.title: India plans first tokenized bonds using wholesale CBDC: Report
articles.snippet: India plans to test tokenized corporate bonds in a September pilot, with state-controlled REC issuing the debt and select investors using wholesale CBDC payments.
